purpose: 以最新可用初始月重新起报，检验「换初始月起报」这条路径；并显式判定能否命中 2026-12。

model.kind: frozen direct ridge map, initial EOF state -> each 1-6 month target anomaly

reachability_rule: target T needs initial M with 0 < T-M <= 6 (direct map, leads 1..6). For T=2026-12: M in 2026-06..2026-11. R1-based inputs end 2026-02 => 2026-12 unreachable (lead 10).
gates: input extension must reproduce 2025-12 from the raw NetCDF with bitwise float32 equality (tolerance 0)
frozen replay: frozen initial state -> frozen forecast must match forecast.npz at atol 1e-12
observation domains computed for the new months must equal the frozen *_domain arrays exactly
channel coefficient block sizes must equal the frozen block sizes
stop_conditions: backfill test fails for any channel
a channel grid or observation domain differs from the frozen projection
prohibited: mixing channels of different end months (e.g. SST 2026-08 with atmosphere 2026-02)
presenting external forecasts (NOAA CPC / CFSv2) as this model's output
using 'checks passed' to dissolve the questioner's data-authenticity reservation
